verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Cloudflare runs its own Workers Builds service: there is a dedicated Workers Builds MCP server, and event subscriptions emit a 'Worker build completing' event. Cloudflare also says Workers fits into Git and GitHub Actions workflows. But nothing explicitly documents a repo connection that builds and deploys automatically on every push. missing for 10: explicit docs of Git repository connection with push-triggered builds/deploys, branch/preview deployment details, independent or hands-on corroboration of push-to-deploy.

support.subject: As a developer, I can automatically deploy my app on every Git push

citations.quote: Fits into your existing workflows: Git, GitHub Actions, VS Code, and any framework.
An event is a structured record of something happening in your Cloudflare account – like a Workers AI batch request being queued, a Worker build completing, or an R2 bucket being created
